sloka: यानि कर्मापदानानि रावणस्य विभीषण ।आख्यातानि च तत्त्वेन ह्यवगच्छामि तान्यहम् ।। ६.१९.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: yāni karmāpadānāni rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇa ।ākhyātāni ca tattvena hyavagacchāmi tānyaham ।। 6.19.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "By Killing the tenheaded Ravana along with Prahastha and relatives I will make you the king. I am telling you, this is true."
